sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的日报简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hear ye, hear ye, hear ye.
sentences.zh: 听着，听着，听着。

sentences.en: All persons are commanded to keep silent on pain of imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 命令所有人保持安静，否则将面临监禁。

sentences.en: The Senate will receive the managers of the House of Representatives to exhibit the articles of impeachment against Donald John Trump, president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 参议院将接待众议院的代表，以展示针对美利坚合众国总统唐纳德·约翰·特朗普的弹劾条款。

sentences.en: We have some very long days yet to come.
sentences.zh: 我们未来还有很长的日子要过。

sentences.en: So let us begin.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: So today was the first big day in the impeachment trial in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 今天参议院弹劾审判迎来了第一个重要日子。

sentences.en: The first of three days in which representatives from the House, these are the impeachment managers, will deliver their opening arguments for a total of 24 hours straight.
sentences.zh: 这是为期三天中的第一天，众议院的代表（即弹劾经理人）将连续进行总计24小时的开庭陈述。

sentences.en: Ever since December, with the impeachment vote in the House, the focus has been on what the trial would actually look like in the Senate, what the process would be.
sentences.zh: 自去年12月众议院投票弹劾以来，焦点一直在于参议院的审判会是什么样子，流程会如何进行。

sentences.en: Now it's actually happening.
sentences.zh: 现在，这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: They are making their case.
sentences.zh: 他们正在陈述自己的理由。

sentences.en: And this has kind of been the nightmare for President Trump, that Democrats would have unfettered, uncontested access to the spotlight and to the microphone
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普总统来说简直是一场噩梦，因为民主党人可以不受限制、不受干扰地占据聚光灯和麦克风，

sentences.en: to make their case against him.
sentences.zh: 来陈述针对他的指控。

sentences.en: And it's well understood that he doesn't like to leave any attack without a counterpunch.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他不希望任何攻击不经过反击就结束。

sentences.en: I'd love to go.
sentences.zh: 我很想去。

sentences.en: Wouldn't that be great?
sentences.zh: 那不是很棒吗？

sentences.en: Wouldn't that be beautiful?
sentences.zh: 那不是很美妙吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'd sort of love sit right in the front row and stare in their corrupt faces.
sentences.zh: 我真想坐在第一排，盯着他们那张腐败的脸看。

sentences.en: I'd love to do it.
sentences.zh: 我很想这么做。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Don't keep talking because I may, you may convince me to do it.
sentences.zh: 别再说了，因为你可能会说服我这么做。

sentences.en: You know, he was in Davos today at the World Economic Forum, but he was clearly paying close attention to this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他今天在达沃斯参加世界经济论坛，但他显然在密切关注这件事。

sentences.en: And he did do his best to punch back in the ways that he could in that moment.
sentences.zh: 而且他确实尽了最大努力，在当时的情况下进行了反击。

sentences.en: It's 830 as I'm recording this, and he's already sent more tweets and retweets than any other day of his presidency.
sentences.zh: 我录制这段视频时是8点30分，他发送的推文和转发量已经超过了他总统任期内的任何一天。

sentences.en: Pursuant to the provisions of Senate Resolution 483, the managers for the House of Representatives have 24 hours to make the presentation of their case.
sentences.zh: 根据参议院第483号决议的规定，众议院的经理人有24小时的时间来陈述他们的案件。

sentences.en: The Senate will now hear you.
sentences.zh: 参议院现在听取你们的陈述。

sentences.en: But the latest is that, for everyone else but the president, today turned out to kind of just be something to get through.
sentences.zh: 但最新消息是，对于总统以外的所有人来说，今天只是熬过去的一天。

sentences.en: President Trump solicited foreign interference in our democratic elections, abusing the power of his office to seek help from abroad to improve his re-election prospects at home.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统寻求外国干预我们的民主选举，滥用职权从国外寻求帮助，以改善他在国内的连任前景。

sentences.en: So Adam Schiff, who led the inquiry in the House, is now the lead manager, essentially the lead prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 因此，领导众议院调查的亚当·希夫现在是首席经理人，本质上就是首席检察官。

sentences.en: And when he was caught, he used the powers of that office to obstruct the investigation into his own misconduct.
sentences.zh: 当他被抓到时，他利用职权阻挠了对他自身不当行为的调查。

sentences.en: And he started the day with a two-and-a-half-hour opening statement, laying out the case by meticulously retelling the Democrats' narrative of what the president did.
sentences.zh: 他以两个半小时的开庭陈述开始了这一天，通过细致地重述民主党人对总统所作所为的叙述来陈述案件。

sentences.en: In this way, the president used official state powers available only to him and unavailable to any political opponent to advantage himself in a democratic election.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，总统利用了只有他自己能用、而任何政治对手都无法使用的国家官方权力，在民主选举中为自己谋取利益。

sentences.en: His scheme was undertaken for a simple but corrupt reason to help him win re-election in 2020.
sentences.zh: 他的计划出于一个简单但腐败的原因：帮助他在2020年赢得连任。

sentences.en: So the main audience for this would seem to be the Republican senators in the room, who are
sentences.zh: 所以，这的主要受众似乎是房间里的共和党参议员，他们

sentences.en: bound to silence, have to sit in their chairs saying nothing for the entirety of the proceeding.
sentences.zh: 被要求保持沉默，必须在整个过程中坐在椅子上一言不发。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, it became clear that this was just kind of a pain in the butt for them to listen to this story again.
sentences.zh: 很快就很清楚，对他们来说，再次听这个故事简直是一种折磨。

sentences.en: They started to fidget.
sentences.zh: 他们开始坐立不安。

sentences.en: Some got up and walked around.
sentences.zh: 有些人站起来走动。

sentences.en: Some left the
sentences.zh: 有些人离开了

sentences.en: Senate chamber.
sentences.zh: 参议院会议厅。

sentences.en: One of them fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人睡着了。

sentences.en: At a certain point, Schiff actually kind of acknowledges the mood in the room.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，希夫实际上承认了房间里的气氛。

sentences.en: While I pause to get a drink of water, let me let you know for your timing,
sentences.zh: 在我停下来喝口水的时候，让我告诉你们时间安排，

sentences.en: I have about 10 minutes left in my presentation.
sentences.zh: 我的陈述还剩下大约10分钟。

sentences.en: So the end is in sight.
sentences.zh: 所以快结束了。

sentences.en: The Democratic senators in the room, nobody's paying much attention to them.
sentences.zh: 房间里的民主党参议员，没人太关注他们。

sentences.en: They're already on board.
sentences.zh: 他们已经站在同一阵线了。

sentences.en: So the other main audience is the American public.
sentences.zh: 所以另一个主要受众是美国公众。

sentences.en: If you've been paying close attention to the impeachment, nothing you would have heard today would have been new.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直密切关注弹劾案，你今天听到的内容都不会是新的。

sentences.en: The framers had common sense, and so must we.
sentences.zh: 制宪者有常识，我们也必须有。

sentences.en: Are we to accept, well, the president said there was no quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 我们要接受吗？好吧，总统说没有交换条件。

sentences.en: I guess that closes the case.
sentences.zh: 我想这案子就结了。

sentences.en: And if you haven't been paying attention, you were probably kind of lost in the details.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直没关注，你可能在细节中迷失了方向。

sentences.en: Obstruction of a separate and co-equal branch of government for the purposes of covering up an abuse of power not only implies a corrupt intent,
sentences.zh: 为了掩盖滥用职权而阻挠政府中一个独立且平等的部门，不仅意味着腐败的意图，

sentences.en: but also demonstrates a remarkable antipathy towards the balance of power contemplated and enshrined in our Constitution.
sentences.zh: 而且还表现出对我们宪法中构想和确立的权力制衡的极度反感。

sentences.en: But what else could the Democrats have done on the first day of opening arguments?
sentences.zh: 但民主党人在开庭陈述的第一天还能做什么呢？

sentences.en: The answer is not really much of anything.
sentences.zh: 答案是其实什么也做不了。

sentences.en: The reality here is that the power of the impeachment process is also its limitation.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，弹劾程序的权力也是它的局限性。

sentences.en: Once it begins, it can't be stopped.
sentences.zh: 一旦开始，就无法停止。

sentences.en: It's sort of like a conveyor belt in that way.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，它有点像传送带。

sentences.en: It's moving forward at the speed it moves forward.
sentences.zh: 它正以既定的速度向前移动。

sentences.en: And that's the way it works.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的运作方式。

sentences.en: And so today, they're in the phase where the Democrats have to lay out their case, which most people are already familiar with.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，他们处于民主党必须陈述案件的阶段，大多数人对此已经很熟悉了。

sentences.en: That's where we're at on this conveyor belt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这条传送带上的位置。

sentences.en: So yeah, that's the lateSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是最新情况。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, another full day of opening arguments in which the Democrats, again, cannot be interrupted.
sentences.zh: 明天，又是完整的一天开庭陈述，民主党人再次不能被打断。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: I'm hoping.
sentences.zh: 我希望。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: Yeah, order to be.
sentences.zh: 是的，肃静。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人时。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
